metadata.title: The symplectic leaves of the affine Poisson $C^\infty$-scheme associated with a singular subalgebroid
metadata.abstract: Every singular subalgebroid, and in particular every singular foliation $\mathscr{G}$, determines a universal Poisson $C^\infty$-scheme $\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G}))$, which is the analogue of the linear Poisson structure on the dual of a Lie algebroid. We show that the underlying space $X_{\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G})}$ of $\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G}))$ decomposes as a disjoint union of symplectic manifolds. Furthermore, we extend the Helffer-Nourrigat cone to a singular subalgebroid and show that it is an embedded Poisson $C^\infty$-subscheme of $\mathrm{Spec}(\mathcal{F}(\mathscr{G}))$.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 为奇异子代数胚关联的通用 Poisson C∞ 概形构造辛叶分解，并推广 Helffer–Nourrigat 锥。
techniques: 奇异叶状结构与 Lie 代数胚
analysis.breakthrough: 证明底空间可分解为互不相交的辛流形，并将推广后的锥实现为嵌入 Poisson 子概形。
analysis.limitations: 结论位于奇异 C∞ 概形框架；辛叶分解不表示整个奇异空间是单一光滑辛流形。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
